text.p: Finnish insurance group Tapiola-yhtiot said on Tuesday its turnover rose to 7.1 billion markka in 1996 from 6.4 billion the year before.
Vahinko-Tapiola's operating profit rose to 347 million markka last year from 131 million in 1995. The operating profit was 16.1 percent of turnover, or well above the sector average, Tapiola said.
Non-life premium income was 1.57 billion, up from 1.52 billion the year before. Net investment income was 395 million markka.
The claims ratio fell to 81.9 percent from 83.6 percent and the combined expense ratio was 101.9 percent, down from 105.7 in 1995.
The combined 1996 profit of life-insurers Henki-Tapiola and Yritysten Henki-Tapiola was 155 million markka, up from 122 million in 1995.
Pension unit Elake-Tapiola's profit rose to 399 million markka from 377 million. Its net investment income was 183 million markka.
